auth_header.description: Base64 encoded Basic Auth header or personal access token.

server_url.description: Base URL of the Bitbucket server (e.g. https://stash.example.com). Must not end with a slash.

tls_skip_verify.description: If true, disables TLS certificate verification. Use only for testing or internal servers.

block.description: Custom provider for Bitbucket token management.

current_token_expiry.description: Expiry of the current token in milliseconds since epoch.

current_token_name.description: Identifier of the currently managed token (e.g., '<prefix>-<epoch_ms>').

token.description: Bitbucket access token secret (only returned on creation; preserved from state if still valid).

token_name.description: Name prefix for the Bitbucket access token. Actual token will be created as '<prefix>-<epoch_ms>'.

block.description: Manages Bitbucket access tokens for a repository. The token secret is only returned when created and is preserved in state for reuse while valid.
